text: Plan every job whose acceptance asks for a 'fails without the fix' run. Athena now runs planned 'fails without the fix' demonstrations and shows them to the verifier (landed 4 Nov, 64cb889), but only when the job has a plan; jobs judged easy skip planning (job_plan mode hard). Job 20261103-231422-8dzf had such a criterion, no plan, so no demonstration ran and the verifier rejected correct code a third time. When any accepted criterion asks for a failing run without the fix (the reading's behavior criteria with fails_without, or criterion text naming 'fails without the fix'), run the planner and critic even if the job is judged easy. Acceptance: a test that an easy job with such a criterion gets a plan and its demonstration record reaches the verifier brief; a test that an easy job without one still skips planning.
